problem: The canonical commercial pricing content existed in prijzen.html and the Netlify build was green, but the public clean URL /prijzen still served a stale generated prijzen/index.html.
root_cause: The commercial pricing composer ran after localized clean-route generation and only rewrote .html sources, leaving clean-route index files stale.
decision: The terminal pricing composer must rewrite both source .html files and the public clean-route index files for NL and EN, and visual/production gates must assert the final composed surface.
prevention: Every terminal public-page composer must write the actual clean route served by Netlify.
Pricing visual regression selectors must match the final composed DOM rather than legacy hero classes.
Production readback must assert the final composed marker data-bg-commercial-pricing-v1 on /prijzen.
